ja214:1.1: The one who drinks when the river is full they say,
ja214:1.2: The one hidden when the barley is grown they say,
ja214:1.3: They call upon him when one has gone far off:
ja214:1.4: Well then, brahmin, you must eat and then come to him.
ja214:2.2: and offers up the crow (to me),
ja214:2.3: (He will offer) geese, herons and peacocks:
